title: scoring_matrix_version
description: A versioned scoring matrix used to evaluate grant applications under a given ProgramVersion. A scoring matrix is not a project outcome, application, or award. Each matrix version must be digest-linked so historical guidance remains traceable.

program_version_ref.description: Reference to the ProgramVersion that governs this scoring matrix.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the scoring matrix document. Required for digest-linked traceability.

supersedes_ref.description: Reference to the prior ScoringMatrixVersion, or null.
